bundle.shortDescription: Control the cursor with hand gestures and a webcam.
bundle.longDescription: AirHand Mouse tracks one hand through an ordinary webcam and drives the operating system cursor from it: move, click, right click, drag and scroll. All computer vision runs locally — there are no cloud services, no API keys and no network calls. Cursor actuation is off at every launch and must be enabled explicitly, and a global hotkey disables it instantly.
